items.name: 潮盐团块
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished inventory sprite for the Chinese survival game 潮汐线. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, never reproduce its objects. Match its restrained realistic survival-game pixel art: crisp small square pixel clusters, thin dark contour, muted material colors, upper-left highlights, 3/4 view slightly from above. Subject: an irregular low wide GRAY-WHITE SALT CLUMP, damp glistening surface, fresh small white frost salt crystal crusts around parts of it, scattered black sand grains and two or three tiny broken seashell fragments embedded in the clump. A single cohesive material lump, no bottle, no holder, no gemstones, no ice. Composition: ONE centered item occupying 80 percent of a square, genuinely transparent alpha background. Designed to read as a 40x40-pixel subject in a 48x48 icon, silhouette and distinctive material first. Enlarged pixel artwork with readable shapes, no smoothing or painterly brushwork. No ground, shadow outside object, scene, labels, text, UI, colored rarity background, magical aura or exaggerated glow.
